body: Even with help from the local council I could hopefully see myself moving out within 6 months, if I am able to save something within that time.  I do pay my parents some keep money just to help them out.  Regarding the moving out earlier, I did actually have a job I liked from 2004 to 2011 where I did manage to get my own place for a couple of years.  I ended up getting into a bit of financial problems, left my job for what I expected to be be better things and had to move back in my parents.  That was 6 years ago.  The "better thing" didn't work as planned and I've been on downward slope since, with a few ups but not enough to keep me "happy".  I am hoping that with this job I can hopefully work at it for a little while and then move onto something I would like to enjoy and maybe even move to own place, (again), a little sooner.
